Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the all-new Valet accessory, which they described as a "wireless charging stand and catchall for your daily essentials."

Now, Twelve South has expanded the Valet lineup with a smaller option that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The original Valet announced earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, offering ample space for a phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and more. The new Valet, however, is significantly smaller at just 4.25 inches.

Here is Twelve South's description of the ultimate premium Valet design:

Valet is designed first as a beautiful home object and second as a precision wireless charger. Warm materials meet modern craftsmanship in a more thoughtful, calm form factor that fits in anywhere at home—from an entryway console to a kitchen counter to a bedside table. The soft, square charging pad mirrors the architectural lines of the leather catchall. A weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and orderly.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet packs plenty of charging capability for your iPhone. It also includes an additional USB-C port for charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 25W wireless charging
  • Premium Nappa leather catchall
  • Four configurable orientations
  • Interchangeable leather trim
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port for up to 10W wired charging
  • 45W power supply and 1.5m USB-C cable included

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is now available for order at $129.99, offered in three color combinations. It's not cheap, but it's a beautiful place to charge your phone while setting down your glasses, wallet, or keys.
